definitions.gloss: wooden construction; timber-frame; made of wood
definitions.explanation: construction using wood as the primary structural material; used to describe buildings, houses, and other structures made primarily of timber

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{木造|もくぞう}⟦{二階建|にかいだ}て→二階建て：03001_nikaidate⟧です。
examples.english: This house is a two-story wooden building.

examples.japanese: {木造|もくぞう}⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Wooden apartments often have lower rent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{木造|もくぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Traditional Japanese architecture is fundamentally wooden construction.

notes:
FORMS:
{木|もく} (wood, tree) + {造|ぞう} (construction, making) → wooden construction

FUNCTIONS AS:
- Noun: {木造|もくぞう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ (wooden building)
- No-adjective: {木造|もくぞう}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (wooden house)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {木造|もくぞう}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (wooden house)
- {木造|もくぞう}⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧ (wooden apartment building)
- {木造|もくぞう}〜⟦{階建|かいだ}て→階建て：29226_kaidate⟧ (wooden ~-story building)

CONSTRUCTION TYPES (used in real estate):
- {木造|もくぞう} (wooden)
- ⟦{鉄骨|てっこつ}→鉄骨：24552_tekkotsu⟧ (steel frame)
- ⟦{鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート→鉄筋コンクリート：17904_tekkinkonkuriito⟧/RC (reinforced concrete)
- {鉄骨鉄筋|てっこつてっきん}⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧/SRC (steel-reinforced concrete)

HOUSING CONTEXT:
{木造|もくぞう} buildings are common in Japan and are generally less expensive than concrete structures. They are often considered to have better natural ventilation but may have less soundproofing.
